Great food in a lovely place.
Jun 2026 • Solo
I had a lovely meal at this place tonight. Spicy prawn pasta and an excellent salad. The food was delicious and the service friendly and professional. The atmosphere was good but I was there early so it was just beginning to get busy as I was leaving. The style and decor are really nice.
Peter the manager was friendly and helpful and gave some useful tips about what to order. He knows his stuff. 
The price was reasonable for the quality and the location only one block from the beach. I have no hesitation in recommending this restaurant for anyone interested in some good value fusion (spanish/italian) food in a great environment served by lovely people.

Good place for Italian and Spanish food
Nov 2025 • Solo
This restaurant was a gem of a find. Located off the main road and housed in what seems like a typical residential home. It’s has both indoor and outdoor seating but no air conditioning. 
Visited the place on a rainy afternoon so practically had the entire place to myself. The food is a bit pricey like all non-local cuisine, but still offers decent value as the portion was good. Presentation of the food was also beautiful, showing the chef’s pride with the cooking. 
Had their Pastafarian and a side order of fried calamari. Both were yummy, especially the pasta. Its meatballs were well seasoned and had just the right amount of heat for a cold wet afternoon, warming both the stomach and heart. Interestingly the calamari came with different coating giving it 2 distinctive colors, which was pleasing on the eye. 
The only reason not rating the place a perfect score is mainly for its ambience. It functional but lacks character so it’s not exactly a place for romantic dining. Also the indoor ventilation could be improved, maybe because it was raining when visit, so their fans were not turned on. But in a humid place like DaNang would be nice to keep the place cool for comfortable dining.
Overall the quality of the food does help overcome its downsides, making this place a good bet for pasta and tapas.
